summary: Implemented the EOM 1.0 core vertical slice: JSON Schema 2020-12 root/core resources, generated types and drift enforcement, strict local parsing and URI/localization helpers, structural and semantic validation, privacy/security/freshness linting, validate/lint/inspect CLI commands, canonical fictional-school fixtures, schema documentation, and executable quickstart. Remote fetch/SSRF client behavior, full public module registry, generator, signatures, adapters, conformance runner, docs app, and external gates remain explicitly in later slices; no registration, certification, legal, factual, or production claim was made.
